run_grammar_constrained_emoji_generation: run the main function to generate emoji-only text using a GPT-2 model constrained by an EBNF grammar
create_incremental_grammar_constraint: create an IncrementalGrammarConstraint from an EBNF grammar file to enforce unicode emoji output
build_grammar_logits_processor: build a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor from a grammar constraint to use with model.generate
generate_constrained_text: generate text from a GPT-2 model using grammar-constrained logits processing with emoji grammar rules
decode_batched_token_ids: decode batched token IDs from model output into human-readable emoji text using batch_decode
